fellows.name: Dr. Rubeena Kidwai
fellows.bio: Provides mental health support through helplines and counseling services to reduce stigma and increase awareness in Pakistan. Played a key role in decriminalizing suicide.

fellows.name: Azima Dhanjee
fellows.bio: Makes hearing aids affordable and accessible to low-income hearing-impaired people through innovative design and financing options.

fellows.name: Habiba Banu
fellows.bio: Provides affordable respiratory care and asthma management tools for low-income patients, addressing the gap in diagnostic capabilities in Pakistan's healthcare system.

fellows.name: Saad Hussain
fellows.bio: Uses AI-powered voice-activated technology in Urdu to help health workers detect maternal health risks early. Improved risk detection from 7% to 40% in pilot testing.

fellows.name: Lala Rukh Fazal-Ur-Rahman
fellows.bio: Brings STEM education to underserved students through hands-on activities and shows. Has impacted 45,000 children and trained 650 teachers across 250 schools in Pakistan.

fellows.name: Khushbakht Shah Jillani
fellows.bio: Uses AI to support domestic violence survivors in Pakistan by analyzing evidence, detecting bias, and generating legal briefs to help accelerate protection orders.

fellows.name: Maira Siddiqui
fellows.bio: Turns Pakistan's school curriculum into gamified cartoons in local languages (Urdu, Punjabi, Pashto). Makes learning accessible via smartphone for grades nursery to 5.

fellows.name: Adnan Qureshi
fellows.bio: Brings digital learning to underserved communities through MicroSchools and smartphone apps. Currently serves 14,317 students across 141 schools with plans to expand significantly.

fellows.name: Muhammad Waqas
fellows.bio: Creates augmented reality games to help children with special needs (autism, cerebral palsy, ADHD) develop physical, cognitive, and social skills. Operating in 45 Pakistani schools.

fellows.name: Ali Siddiq
fellows.bio: Bridges the gap between university education and job market through a 3-month fellowship teaching critical thinking and professional skills. 81% of graduates are employed within 3 months.

fellows.name: Osama Shahid
fellows.bio: Empowers marginalized communities through fair trade practices and direct market linkages, ensuring farmers and artisans receive fair prices for their products.
